read_for_work_review: only idea/problem records selected as relevant from records/PENDING_INDEX.md
only normalized materials linked by those relevant records when needed

authority.llm-source/PROJECT_REPOSITORIES.md: verified locator for company-related GitHub repositories; not implementation status by itself
authority.llm-source/WORK_GOVERNANCE.md: official workflow rule for work review/share/confirmation
authority.working/CURRENT_WORK.md: current progress and discussion; not automatically official
authority.records/PENDING_INDEX.md: lightweight index of unreflected ideas/problems; used to choose relevant records
authority.records/ideas/**: saved proposal; non-authoritative until admin reflection
authority.records/problems/**: saved problem; non-authoritative until admin reflection
authority.materials/normalized/**: LLM-readable supporting material; not automatically official

pending_rule: During /업무검토, read records/PENDING_INDEX.md first, then open only directly relevant unreflected idea/problem records. Do not scan all records.
project_repository_rule: Use llm-source/PROJECT_REPOSITORIES.md to locate project repositories. When a question depends on actual implementation status or recent code, inspect that repository's latest main instead of inferring from the registry.
answer_rule: If current work conflicts with official source, state both separately as 현재 확정 기준 and 현재 협의/진행 중. Never promote a saved idea/problem or working item to official status without admin confirmation.
raw_read_rule: Do not repeatedly read all ideas, problems, normalized materials, originals, archive, or DB folders. Read them only when selected as relevant or when the current request directly requires them.
